brief:
Israeli settlers attacked Atara, a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank, on Thursday, injuring five people, according to a rights group. The settlers entered the community in what witnesses described as a coordinated assault.

The identities of those wounded and the full circumstances of the attack remained unclear. No immediate statement was available from Israeli authorities regarding the incident.
dek: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians Israeli settlers stormed Atara, a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank and injured five people on Thursday, a rights group said.
title: Israeli settlers injure five Palestinians in West Bank raid
